Case Facts: In White v. Carmichael Industries, the plaintiff, Ms. White, alleges that her contract was unlawfully terminated in retaliation for raising concerns about environmental violations within the company. She seeks damages for whistleblower retaliation. Carmichael Industries defends the termination by claiming it was due to organizational restructuring and unrelated to Ms. White's allegations.

Major Legal Points: The case centers on the legal concept of whistleblower retaliation and the burden of proof regarding the true motive for termination (retaliation vs. legitimate business restructuring).
